title: CoPreGeneric DRAFT Ready Cycle | CoLatch + CoReGroup + CoBoogie + Break Glass

interface.seed: one versioned manifest pointer to content-addressed records; not a single point of failure
interface.orb: one coherent status surface rendering evidence, blockers, and next act
interface.gauge: one composite evidence-grounded score with published components; never conceal blockers in averages
interface.thumb: one short stable pointer-only action, idempotent and reversible
interface.time: one UTC source field plus observed_at, source clock, skew, and monotonic elapsed where supported

cycle: Challenge with independent adversaries and inverse hypotheses
Deduplicate by identity, content hash and causal equivalence
Verify via repeated controls and novel holdouts
Publish only consented sanitized artifacts and SHA receipts
Latch durable checkpoint and tested handoff
Stop this cycle on diminishing expected information gain; schedule triggers for future reevaluation

wave_policy.exploration: Prefer diverse independent hypotheses, modalities, time horizons and failure modes
wave_policy.replication: Repeat identical trials when needed for falsifiability, reproducibility and drift detection
wave_policy.novelty_measure: Measure semantic and causal novelty rather than enforcing unique wording
wave_policy.no_infinite_spin: Bound compute, cost and risk; no claim of exhausting all possible improvements

gates.seed_survives_24h: NOT_TESTED; requires durable external store, kill/restart and delayed verification
gates.handoff_once: NOT_TESTED; requires independent consumer read, acknowledge and receipt
gates.system_1_user_0: NOT_PROVEN; requires authenticated receiver, scheduled or event-driven workers and safe actuation
gates.cross_session_sync: NOT_PROVEN; independent sessions cannot be assumed to read each other's context
gates.mirrors_identical: NOT_PROVEN; require exact bytes and SHA-256 comparison for all endpoints
gates.public_release: Draft-only safe publication, not authorization for personal data, secrets or credentials

break_glass: Fail closed on missing evidence, unsafe privacy, stale authority or conflicting writers
Preserve last known good checkpoint and non-destructive incident record
One elected actuator; observers may propose but not race writes
Require human approval for irreversible, financial, credential, personal outreach, canon or authority changes
Reconcile with content hashes, compare-and-swap leases, replay-safe event IDs
next_test: Create a non-sensitive seed and receipt; verify exact bytes from independent consumer after 24h, with one restart and one handoff; no success claim before evidence.
relations: CoPre/CiPre/CoPrompt are interface aliases pending explicit version mapping
CoEv+ operates over the bounded cycle and source-bound evolutionary receipts
CoHog+ adversarial feedback may provide challenges and independent rewards but no live bounty is asserted
